title: The Kite of the Storm Peaks
story: High above the Storm Peaks, Thunderquill the Sky Porcupine has snagged a shepherd girl's kite string and is dragging her sled-basket upward. Mr 6 grabs the winch rope, boots braced on the cliff, and starts reeling. The porcupine climbs steadily, so Mr 6 must know exactly how long the rescue will take before he runs out of rope.
question: Thunderquill rises 14 meters every minute while Mr 6 winches the basket down 26 meters every minute. If the basket starts 96 meters above the ledge, how many minutes until it reaches the ledge?
hint: Each minute, the basket only really drops by the winch speed MINUS the monster's climb. Find that net drop first.
victory: The basket thumped safely onto the ledge with rope to spare, and Thunderquill — out-mathed and out of altitude — flumped down to become the world's spikiest kite anchor.
imagePrompt: A brave numeral-six knight in a blue cape braces on a windy cliff edge cranking a winch as a bristling storm-cloud porcupine tugs a rescue basket skyward, lightning glowing behind the peaks.
